questions.q: Which layer of the TCP/IP model corresponds to the network layer of the OSI model?
questions.exp: The Internet layer (IP) of TCP/IP corresponds to the OSI network layer.

questions.q: Every pair among 20 users must share a distinct secret key for symmetric encryption. How many keys are needed?
What is the minimum number of nodes in an AVL tree of height 4? (Height of a single-node tree is 0.)

What is the output of the following code?
s = "Hello, World"
print(s.lower().count("l"), s.replace("l", "L", 2), s.partition(", ")[2])
questions.exp: There are three l's; replace with count 2 changes only the first two; partition gives the part after ', '.

questions.q: Class and object are the central concepts of which programming paradigm?
questions.exp: Object-oriented programming organises software around objects created from classes.

questions.q: A disk block is 1024 bytes. A key takes 8 bytes and a pointer takes 8 bytes. What is the maximum number of pointers (order p) an internal B+ tree node can hold if it has p pointers and p − 1 keys?
Page size is 1 KB and page 2 of a process is mapped to frame 7. What physical address corresponds to logical address 2100?
Which of the following is NOT a recognised type of inheritance in OOP?
questions.exp: Single, multiple, multilevel, hierarchical and hybrid are standard types; circular inheritance is illegal.

questions.q: Emp(eid, did) has a foreign key did referencing Dept(did) declared with ON DELETE CASCADE. What happens when a Dept row is deleted?
options: did in the Emp rows is set to its default only
All Emp rows referencing that department are also deleted
questions.exp: ON DELETE CASCADE propagates the deletion to the referencing child rows to preserve referential integrity.

questions.q: Which package of Java is imported automatically into every program?
questions.exp: java.lang (String, Object, System, Math) is implicitly imported.

questions.q: The Floyd–Warshall algorithm for all-pairs shortest paths on a graph with n vertices runs in time
questions.exp: Three nested loops over k, i, j each run n times.

questions.q: In a UML class diagram, a line ending in a hollow (unfilled) diamond represents:
questions.exp: Hollow diamond is aggregation (weak has-a); a filled diamond is composition.

questions.q: Reference string: 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5 with 3 frames and LRU replacement. How many page faults occur?
questions.exp: Faults at 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,3,4,5 = 10 (only the two middle references to 1 and 2 hit).

questions.q: Which field of the TCP header is used by the receiver to implement flow control?
questions.exp: The receiver advertises its available buffer space through the window size field.

questions.q: A full backup is taken every Sunday and an incremental backup every night from Monday to Saturday. The system fails on Thursday morning. How many backup sets are needed to restore it?
questions.exp: Restore requires the Sunday full plus incrementals of Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday: 1 + 3 = 4.

questions.q: Compared with interrupt-driven I/O, polling:
options: is always faster for slow devices
makes the CPU repeatedly check the device status, wasting CPU time
questions.exp: In polling the CPU busy-waits on a status bit; interrupt-driven I/O lets the CPU do other work.

questions.q: A point (2, 0) is rotated by 90° counter-clockwise about the origin. Its new coordinates are
questions.exp: x' = x cos90° − y sin90° = 0, y' = x sin90° + y cos90° = 2.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
x = 10
def f():
    x = 5
    def g():
        global x
        x += 1
    g()
    return x
print(f(), x)
questions.exp: g changes the global x (10 to 11), while f returns its own local x which is still 5.

questions.q: Round Robin with time quantum 3 ms. P1, P2, P3 all arrive at 0 with bursts 7, 4 and 2 ms respectively (in that order). At what time does P2 complete?
In Java, the finally block:
options: Executes only when an exception is thrown
Executes whether or not an exception occurs
Executes only when no exception occurs
Cannot be used without a catch block
questions.exp: finally is meant for clean-up and runs in both normal and exceptional flow (and may follow try alone).

questions.q: Which of the following machines is strictly LESS powerful than a standard single-tape Turing machine?
options: Turing machine with a two-way infinite tape
questions.exp: Multi-tape, nondeterministic and two-way tape variants all accept the same languages as a standard TM; a PDA accepts only CFLs.

questions.q: Which type of cohesion is the strongest (most desirable)?
questions.exp: Functional cohesion, where all elements contribute to a single well-defined task, is the highest level of cohesion.

questions.q: In the 4-queens problem, the first queen is placed at row 1, column 1. Scanning columns from left to right, the leftmost safe column for the queen in row 2 is
questions.exp: Column 1 shares the column and column 2 shares the diagonal with the first queen; column 3 is the first safe one.

questions.q: A noiseless channel has a bandwidth of 4 kHz and uses 8 signal levels. What is the maximum bit rate by Nyquist's theorem?
An undirected graph has 8 vertices and 11 edges. How many entries equal 1 in its adjacency matrix?
questions.exp: Each undirected edge sets two entries (A[i][j] and A[j][i]), so 2 × 11 = 22.

questions.q: Which CPU register is used to hold intermediate results of ALU operations in a simple one-address machine?
questions.exp: The accumulator holds one operand and receives the ALU result.
Elements not explicitly initialised in a partially initialised array are set to 0, so a[3] + a[4] = 0.

questions.q: A project has an Unadjusted Function Point count of 125 and the sum of the 14 general system characteristic ratings is 30. Using FP = UFP × (0.65 + 0.01 × ΣFi), the function point count is
A page fault occurs when
options: The CPU tries to write to read-only memory
A required block is not found in the cache
The referenced page is not present in main memory
questions.exp: A page fault is raised when the page needed is not resident in main memory and must be brought in from disk.

questions.q: The internal data RAM of the 8051 is
questions.exp: The 8051 has 128 bytes of on-chip data RAM (the 8052 has 256 bytes).

questions.q: What does the option -i do in the command grep -i "error" log.txt?
options: Ignores the case of letters while matching
questions.exp: -i makes grep case-insensitive, so Error, ERROR and error all match.

questions.q: Which of the 8085 interrupts is a non-vectored interrupt, i.e. the interrupting device must supply the instruction/vector?
questions.exp: INTR is non-vectored; the external device places an RST or CALL opcode on the data bus in response to INTA. The others have fixed vector addresses.

questions.q: Which statement about software maintenance is correct?
options: It usually consumes the largest share of the total life-cycle cost
It accounts for less than 10% of life-cycle cost in most projects
It is required only during the first month after delivery
It always costs exactly the same as development
questions.exp: Studies consistently show maintenance consumes a major (often majority) share of total software life-cycle cost.

questions.q: The CAP theorem states that a distributed data store can simultaneously guarantee at most two of which three properties?
questions.exp: CAP: Consistency, Availability and Partition tolerance; during a network partition, a system must choose between C and A.

questions.q:
What is the output?
console.log(2 + "3" - 1);
questions.exp: 2 + "3" gives the string "23"; "23" - 1 coerces to number giving 22.

questions.q: In which switching technique are the packets of one message routed independently and may arrive out of order?
questions.exp: In datagram switching each packet is routed independently, so packets can take different paths and arrive out of order.

questions.q: The stored-program concept, on which modern computers are based, is credited to
questions.exp: The von Neumann architecture keeps both instructions and data in the same memory.

questions.q: A company invents a new type of water-purification machine and wants exclusive rights over the invention. Which form of IPR applies?
questions.exp: Patents protect new, useful, non-obvious inventions.

questions.q: Which statement correctly distinguishes forward chaining from backward chaining?
options: Forward chaining is goal-driven and backward chaining is data-driven
Forward chaining is data-driven and backward chaining is goal-driven
questions.exp: Forward chaining starts from known facts and derives new ones; backward chaining starts from a goal and looks for supporting facts.

questions.q: Which HTTP method is idempotent and is normally used to replace an existing resource completely?
questions.exp: PUT replaces the target resource with the supplied representation; repeating it gives the same result.

questions.q: A cloud infrastructure shared by several organizations that have common concerns such as security requirements and compliance policies is called a:
questions.exp: Community cloud serves a specific community of organizations with shared concerns.

questions.q: How many strings of length 3 over {0,1} belong to the language of the regular expression 0*1*?
questions.exp: Strings are 0^i 1^(3-i) for i = 0..3: 111, 011, 001, 000, which are 4 strings.

questions.q:
Match the protocol with its default port.
P. SMTP  Q. POP3  R. FTP (control)  S. DNS
1. 110  2. 21  3. 53  4. 25
questions.exp: SMTP uses 25, POP3 uses 110, FTP control uses 21 and DNS uses 53.

questions.q: Which of the following was the first general-purpose electronic digital computer, completed in 1946?
questions.exp: ENIAC (1946) was the first large general-purpose electronic computer; Mark I was electromechanical and EDSAC (1949) was stored-program.

questions.q: The default TCP port used by HTTPS is
questions.exp: HTTP uses 80, SSH 22 and SMTP 25; HTTPS (HTTP over TLS) uses 443.

questions.q: Which statement correctly gives the time and extra space needed to reverse a singly linked list of n nodes iteratively?
options: O(n) time and O(n) extra space
O(n) time and O(1) extra space
O(n²) time and O(1) extra space
O(log n) time and O(1) extra space
questions.exp: One pass changes each node's next pointer using three pointers, so it is O(n) time and O(1) space.

questions.q: In MS Excel, which shortcut inserts the current system date in the active cell?
questions.exp: Ctrl+; inserts the date, Ctrl+Shift+; inserts the time and Ctrl+D fills down.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
import numpy as np
a = np.array([1, 2, 3])
b = np.array([[1], [2]])
print((a + b).shape)
questions.exp: Broadcasting a shape (3,) with (2,1) gives (2,3).

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a keyword in C?
questions.exp: 'define' is part of the #define preprocessor directive, not a C keyword.

questions.q: The dual of the Boolean expression A + BC' is
questions.exp: Duality swaps AND with OR (and 0 with 1) without complementing variables: A + BC' → A·(B + C').

questions.q: A disk of 128 MB uses 2 KB blocks and a FAT with 2-byte entries (one entry per block). What is the size of the FAT?
questions.exp: Blocks = 128 MB / 2 KB = 65,536 entries; × 2 B = 131,072 B = 128 KB.

questions.q: In which mode should a file be opened to store an object with pickle.dump()?
questions.exp: pickle writes bytes, so the file must be opened in binary write mode.

questions.q: For using a semaphore to enforce mutual exclusion among processes, the semaphore is initialised to:
questions.exp: A binary semaphore initialised to 1 lets exactly one process enter the critical section.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a semantic element in HTML5?
questions.exp: <div> has no meaning on its own; nav, footer and aside describe their content.

questions.q: A non-pipelined unit takes 50 ns per instruction. A 5-stage pipeline with 10 ns stages executes 100 instructions. The speedup obtained is approximately
questions.exp: Non-pipelined = 100 × 50 = 5000 ns; pipelined = (5 + 99) × 10 = 1040 ns; speedup = 5000/1040 ≈ 4.81.

questions.q: Which statement about passive RFID tags is correct?
options: They carry an internal battery that lets them transmit for kilometres
They work only when connected to a Wi-Fi router
They have no battery and are powered by the reader's radio-frequency field
They require a SIM card to transmit
questions.exp: Passive tags harvest energy from the reader's RF signal to respond.

questions.q: A 4K × 8 ROM has how many address lines and data lines respectively?
questions.exp: 4K = 2¹² words, so 12 address lines; each word is 8 bits, so 8 data lines.
The dot is the concatenation operator, so the strings "5" and "3" join to give 53.

questions.q:
Table Sales(region, amt): (E,10), (E,20), (W,5), (W,15), (W,25), (N,30). What is the result of
SELECT region, SUM(amt) FROM Sales GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amt) > 30;
questions.exp: Sums: E = 30, W = 45, N = 30. HAVING keeps only groups with sum > 30, which is W.

questions.q: Which system program combines several object modules and resolves references between them to produce an executable?
questions.exp: The linker resolves external symbol references across object modules.

questions.q: In a flowchart, which symbol is used to represent a decision (yes/no branching)?
questions.exp: The diamond (rhombus) symbol is used for decision making; the rectangle is a process, parallelogram is input/output and oval is start/stop.

questions.q: A single-precision IEEE 754 word has sign = 1, exponent = 10000001 and mantissa = 0100...0 (23 bits). Its value is
questions.exp: Exponent = 129 - 127 = 2; significand = 1.01₂ = 1.25; value = -1.25 × 4 = -5.0.

questions.q: If an NP-complete problem X is shown to be solvable in polynomial time, then
questions.exp: Every NP problem reduces to X in polynomial time, so all of NP would be in P.

questions.q: Which is the correct declaration of a pure virtual function in C++?
questions.exp: A pure virtual function is declared with = 0 after the declarator.

questions.q: The main purpose of regression testing is to
options: Test only the newly added feature
Measure system performance under heavy load
Verify that changes have not broken previously working functionality
questions.exp: Regression testing re-runs earlier tests after modification to catch unintended side effects.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a task of the lexical analyzer?
options: Keeping track of line numbers for error messages
questions.exp: Checking balanced parentheses requires a stack and belongs to the parser.

questions.q: Using the CRC generator polynomial x³ + x + 1 (1011), what is the CRC to be appended to data 1101?
questions.exp: Dividing 1101000 by 1011 (mod-2) leaves remainder 001, so the transmitted word is 1101001.

questions.q: Which of the following relational algebra equivalences is correct?
options: σ_c(R × S) = σ_c(R) × S for any condition c
questions.exp: Selection conditions can be cascaded. Projection distributes over union, not intersection; set difference is not commutative; the last holds only if c uses attributes of R alone.

questions.q: A login query is: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='$u' AND pass='$p'. An attacker enters admin' -- as the username and anything as the password. What is the likely result?
options: The password check is commented out and the attacker logs in as admin
The server always returns a syntax error
The password is automatically hashed and compared
questions.exp: The quote closes the name string and -- starts a comment, so the AND pass condition is ignored.

questions.q: The output of a sigmoid activation function for an input of 0 is
A member of a Java class declared protected is accessible:
options: Within its package and by subclasses in other packages
questions.exp: protected gives package access plus access through inheritance in other packages.

questions.q: Context-free languages are NOT closed under which operation?
questions.exp: CFLs are closed under union, concatenation and star, but intersection of {a^n b^n c^m} and {a^m b^n c^n} gives {a^n b^n c^n}, which is not CFL.

questions.q: Which control word configures the 8255 with Port A, Port B and both halves of Port C as inputs in Mode 0?
questions.exp: D7 = 1, modes = 0, and A, C-upper, B and C-lower all input gives 1001 1011 = 9BH.

questions.q: Which tag is essential for making a page scale properly on mobile devices in responsive design?
questions.exp: The viewport meta tag tells mobile browsers to match the device width and set initial zoom.

questions.q: What is the time complexity of building a binary heap from n unordered elements using the bottom-up (Floyd) method?
questions.exp: Most nodes are near the leaves and sift down only a few levels, so the total work sums to O(n).

questions.q: A hash table of size 50 currently stores 35 keys. What is its load factor?
questions.exp: Load factor α = number of keys / table size = 35/50 = 0.7.

questions.q: What is the size of the instruction prefetch queue of the 8086?
questions.exp: The 8086 has a 6-byte queue (the 8088 has a 4-byte queue).

questions.q: A 6 × 6 lower triangular matrix is stored in a one-dimensional array keeping only the elements on and below the diagonal. How many elements are stored?

Statement I: In a PLA both the AND array and the OR array are programmable.
Statement II: In a PAL only the OR array is programmable.
Which is correct?
options: Statement I is true and Statement II is false
Statement I is false and Statement II is true
questions.exp: In a PAL the AND array is programmable and the OR array is fixed, so Statement II is false.

questions.q: In programmed I/O, the CPU repeatedly checking the status register of a device until it is ready is called
questions.exp: Repeatedly testing device status in a loop (busy waiting) is polling.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
def add(v, L=[]):
    L.append(v)
    return L
print(add(1), add(2), add(3, [9]))
questions.exp: The default list is created once and shared; the first two calls return the same list object holding [1, 2].

questions.q: In a non-static member function of a C++ class, the this pointer points to:
options: The object on which the function was invoked
The base class of the current class
The first member of the class
questions.exp: this holds the address of the invoking (current) object.

questions.q: Zero-address instructions are characteristic of which type of machine organization?
questions.exp: Stack machines take operands implicitly from the top of the stack, so arithmetic instructions need no address field.

questions.q: Strict two-phase locking guarantees that every schedule produced is
options: only view serializable but never conflict serializable
questions.exp: 2PL ensures conflict serializability; strict 2PL, holding exclusive locks until commit, additionally avoids cascading rollbacks. It does not prevent deadlock.

questions.q: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) in India was developed by:
questions.exp: UPI was developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI).

questions.q: The hexadecimal number (2F8)₁₆ equals which decimal number?
Which statement about pushdown automata is TRUE?
options: Deterministic and nondeterministic PDAs accept the same languages
A PDA with two stacks is equivalent to a PDA with one stack
Acceptance by final state and acceptance by empty stack define the same class of languages
PDAs accept exactly the regular languages
questions.exp: The two acceptance modes can be converted into each other; the other statements are false.

questions.q: Matrices A (10×20), B (20×30) and C (30×40) are to be multiplied. The minimum number of scalar multiplications is
Using the divide and conquer method to find both the maximum and minimum of 8 elements (n a power of 2), the number of comparisons needed is
Insertion sort is applied to the array 7 3 5 1. What does the array look like after the first two insertions (the first two passes)?
questions.exp: Pass 1 inserts 3 giving 3 7 5 1; pass 2 inserts 5 giving 3 5 7 1.

questions.q: A system has 12 tape drives. Maximum demands / current allocations: P0 10/5, P1 4/2, P2 9/2. Which sequence is safe?
questions.exp: Available = 12 - 9 = 3; needs: P0 5, P1 2, P2 7. P1 runs → avail 5; P0 runs → avail 10; P2 (7 ≤ 10) runs.

questions.q: Which of the following is a valid Python identifier?
questions.exp: Identifiers cannot start with a digit, contain hyphens or be keywords.

questions.q: The instruction MOV AX,[BX+SI+08H] in the 8086 uses which addressing mode?
questions.exp: A base register (BX), an index register (SI) and an 8-bit displacement are all added, which is based indexed addressing with displacement.

questions.q: The Excess-3 code of the decimal digit 6 is
For F = {A → BC, B → C, A → B, AB → C}, how many functional dependencies are there in a minimal (canonical) cover of F?
questions.exp: Split A → BC; A → C and AB → C are redundant (A → B → C). The minimal cover is {A → B, B → C}: 2 dependencies.

questions.q: In a generalization/specialization hierarchy, specialization is best described as a
options: bottom-up process of merging entity sets
top-down process of defining sub-groups of an entity set with distinguishing attributes
process of converting attributes into relationships
questions.exp: Specialization starts with a general entity set and defines more specific sub-classes; generalization is the reverse, bottom-up.

questions.q: Integers 1, 2, 3, 4 are pushed onto a stack in this order, with pops allowed at any time between pushes. Which of the following pop sequences is NOT possible?
questions.exp: Once 3 is popped the stack holds 1 below 2, so 2 must be popped before 1. The sequence 3 1 2 4 violates this.

questions.q: The main purpose of histogram equalization of an image is to
options: improve the contrast of the image
reduce the file size of the image
questions.exp: Equalization spreads the gray levels over the full range, enhancing global contrast.

questions.q: Jobs with (deadline, profit): J1 (2,100), J2 (1,19), J3 (2,27), J4 (1,25), J5 (3,15). Each job takes unit time. The maximum profit obtainable by greedy job sequencing is
questions.exp: Sorted by profit: J1 takes slot 2, J3 slot 1, J4 and J2 rejected, J5 slot 3. Profit 100+27+15 = 142.

questions.q: Which of the following is a 3G mobile technology?
questions.exp: WCDMA (UMTS) is a 3G technology; GSM is 2G, GPRS 2.5G and EDGE 2.75G.

questions.q: Salivation at the sound of the bell alone, after repeated pairing with food, is the
questions.exp: A learned response to a conditioned stimulus is a conditioned response.

questions.q: Which is the correct cycle of action research?
questions.exp: The cycle repeats with the revised plan after reflection.

questions.q: The onset of sexual maturity with rapid physical changes is called
questions.exp: Puberty marks the beginning of reproductive capability.

questions.q: 'Learning by doing' is the central slogan of
questions.exp: Dewey's pragmatism stresses experience and activity.

questions.q: The RTE Act covers children in the age group
questions.exp: It provides free and compulsory elementary education for ages 6-14.

questions.q: Non-directive or client-centred counselling was developed by
questions.exp: Rogers emphasised the client's own capacity for growth.

questions.q: A child has an IQ of 75 and a chronological age of 16 years. What is the mental age?
A student lists 20 possible uses of a brick. This score mainly shows
questions.exp: Fluency is the number of relevant ideas produced.

questions.q: In microteaching, a teacher trainee practises:
options: one specific teaching skill at a time
questions.exp: Focusing on a single skill makes feedback and improvement manageable.

questions.q: In Freud's theory, the part of personality that works on the reality principle is the
questions.exp: The ego balances the demands of the id with the real world.

questions.q: Enrichment programmes are designed mainly for:
questions.exp: Enrichment adds depth and challenge for talented children.

questions.q: Which sequence of Maslow's needs from lower to higher is correct?
questions.exp: This is the standard order of the hierarchy.

questions.q: In a symposium:
options: several speakers present different aspects of a single topic before an audience
students enact characters in a drama
a teacher dictates notes to the class
questions.exp: A symposium is a series of short prepared talks on different aspects of the same theme.

questions.q: Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation (CCE) was mandated for elementary education under:
questions.exp: Section 29 of the RTE Act, 2009 provides for CCE.

questions.q: According to Thorndike's Law of Exercise, connections are strengthened by
questions.exp: Practice strengthens S-R bonds, and disuse weakens them.

questions.q: In the modern view, the teacher's role is best described as:
questions.exp: The teacher guides and supports learners in constructing knowledge.

questions.q: An overhead projector (OHP) is classified as a:
questions.exp: OHP projects transparencies on a screen so it is a projected visual aid.

questions.q: In the split-half method, the test is commonly divided into:
questions.exp: The correlation of half-scores is stepped up by the Spearman-Brown formula.

questions.q: SWAYAM Prabha is:
options: a group of DTH educational channels that telecast high-quality programmes
questions.exp: It broadcasts educational content 24x7 through DTH channels.

questions.q: NEP 2020 recommends that, wherever possible, the medium of instruction till at least Grade 5 should be:
options: the home language, mother tongue or local language
questions.exp: Children learn most easily in their home language.

questions.q: In an MCQ, the incorrect options are called:
questions.exp: Distractors are plausible wrong options; the correct one is the key.

questions.q: Learning is best defined as:
options: a change caused only by growth and maturation
a change caused by fatigue or drugs
a relatively permanent change in behaviour brought about by experience or practice
questions.exp: Maturation, fatigue and drugs produce temporary or non-learned changes, so they are excluded from the definition.

questions.q: Which of the following verbs is NOT suitable for writing a specific measurable objective?
questions.exp: 'Appreciate' describes an internal state that cannot be directly observed.

questions.q: An integrated curriculum is one in which:
options: subject boundaries are reduced and related content is combined around themes
each subject is taught fully separately
questions.exp: Integration links knowledge from different subjects.

questions.q: Vivekananda founded the Ramakrishna Mission in
questions.exp: The Mission was founded in 1897.

questions.q: Pair programming in the classroom is an approach where:
options: two students work together at one computer, one coding and the other reviewing
each student works with different tasks silently
questions.exp: It promotes collaboration and fewer errors.

questions.q: Differences in a single person's abilities, e.g., good in maths but weak in language, are called
questions.exp: Intra-individual differences exist within the same person.

questions.q: Dyslexia is a learning disability related to
questions.exp: Dyslexia affects the ability to read and decode words.

questions.q: Which approach to discipline is best?
questions.exp: Preventing problems through planning and engagement is most effective.

questions.q: Gandhi favoured which medium of instruction?
questions.exp: He considered education through the mother tongue natural and effective.

questions.q: Which gas forms the largest percentage of Earth's atmosphere by volume?
questions.exp: Dry air contains about 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen.

questions.q: Who founded the Mauryan Empire in 322 BCE with the help of Kautilya?
questions.exp: Chandragupta Maurya overthrew the Nandas and founded the Maurya empire with Chanakya's guidance.

questions.q:
Statement I: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area.
Statement II: Goa is the smallest Indian state by area.
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
questions.exp: Rajasthan (about 3.42 lakh sq km) is the largest state and Goa the smallest by area; both statements are true.

questions.q: Madhubani painting is a traditional folk art of which region of Bihar?
questions.exp: Madhubani (Mithila) painting originated in the Mithila region of north Bihar.

questions.q: What is the term of a member of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.exp: Rajya Sabha is a permanent house; each member serves a six-year term, with one-third retiring every two years.

questions.q: Biomagnification refers to the
options: Decrease in energy at higher trophic levels
Increase in concentration of a non-degradable toxin at successive trophic levels
questions.exp: Substances such as DDT and mercury accumulate and are present in higher concentration at higher trophic levels.

questions.q: The Silent Valley movement in Kerala was launched to oppose
options: A hydroelectric project on the Kunthipuzha river
A mining project in the Western Ghats
A highway through a tiger reserve
questions.exp: The protest saved the Silent Valley rainforest and led to a National Park (1985).

questions.q: The Ramsar Convention, 1971, deals with the conservation of
questions.exp: Ramsar (Iran) Convention provides for wise use and conservation of wetlands.

questions.q: Which of the following is a non-renewable source of energy?
questions.exp: Natural gas is a fossil fuel formed over millions of years and cannot be replenished quickly.

questions.q: A solar photovoltaic cell converts
questions.exp: Photovoltaic cells (usually silicon) use the photoelectric effect to produce electricity from sunlight.

questions.q: The price of an article is increased by 20% and then the new price is decreased by 20%. What is the net change in the price?
questions.exp: Final price = 1.2 x 0.8 = 0.96 of the original, i.e. a 4% decrease.

questions.q: What is the HCF of 84 and 126?
questions.exp: 84 = 2²x3x7 and 126 = 2x3²x7, so HCF = 2x3x7 = 42.

questions.q: The marked price of a shirt is Rs 900 and a discount of 15% is given. What is the selling price?
The circumference of a circle is 44 cm. What is its area? (take π = 22/7)
questions.exp: 2πr = 44 gives r = 7 cm; area = πr² = 22/7 x 49 = 154 cm².

questions.q: A shop sold 120, 150, 90 and 140 units in four consecutive months. What is the average monthly sale?
Find the next term: B, E, I, N, T, ?
questions.exp: Differences in position are +3, +4, +5, +6, then +7: T (20) + 7 = 27, which wraps around to A.

questions.q: In a certain code language, 'sun rises early' is written 'ka mo pa', 'early bird sings' is written 'pa ti ro' and 'sun bird shines' is written 'ka ti ne'. What is the code for 'bird'?
questions.exp: 'bird' is the only word common to the second and third statements, and 'ti' is the only code common to them.

questions.q: A is the sister of B. C is the mother of B. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
questions.exp: C is the mother of both A and B; D is C's father. So A is D's granddaughter.

questions.q: A person facing south turns 135° anticlockwise and then 90° clockwise. In which direction is he facing now?
questions.exp: From south, anticlockwise turns go via east: 135° anticlockwise gives north-east. Then 90° clockwise from north-east gives south-east.

questions.q: A is taller than B but shorter than C. D is taller than C. E is shorter than B. Who is the second tallest?
questions.exp: Order: D > C > A > B > E. The second tallest is C.
